original_enactment: 1965 — California first US state to enact crime victim compensation program

recodification.effect: Moved from former Art. 1 of Ch. 5 to current Ch. 5 of Part 4; renumbered sections; preserved cross-references via § 13950(c)

major_amendments_summary: 1970s: added derivative victim and mental health counseling
1982: Cal. Const. Art. I § 28 (Prop 8 victims' bill of rights)
1984: federal VOCA (42 USC § 10601) authorized matching funds
1999: expanded emotional-injury-only coverage and loosened police-report rule
Post-2008: human trafficking, military sexual assault, inflation cap adjustments
source: Pre-2002 statutory history traced through Deering's and West's annotation histories. Post-2002 statutory history traced through the Stats. chapter citations visible in the current codified text.
